text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Data Analyst Intern position at Harbor Health Tech. As a student currently pursuing a B.Com (Hons) with a minor in Statistics at Coastal University, I am eager to bring my analytical background and practical internship experience to your team.

During my recent internship as an Operations Analyst Intern at Tidepool Logistics, I developed hands-on technical skills that align closely with the data needs of a fast-paced organization. I regularly cleaned shipment data in Excel using pivot tables and VLOOKUP, and I built weekly dashboards in Power BI for the operations lead. Additionally, I wrote SQL queries to identify delayed shipments, creating a report that is now used every Monday, and I presented these findings to a team of 10 in PowerPoint. 

Beyond my internship, I have applied analytical techniques to solve practical problems. For a college project, I analyzed two years of canteen sales using Python with pandas and matplotlib, which led to suggested menu changes that cut waste by 15%. I have also built a Google Analytics 4 and Looker Studio dashboard for a student club website, and I hold the Google Data Analytics Certificate.

While Excel, SQL, and Power BI are core tools I use regularly, I am also keen to expand my skill set to meet any additional requirements of Harbor Health Tech. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in statistics and operations analysis can support your team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Alex Rao
